question: The value of (2)/(5)+((1)/(1+frac{4){9}}) - (4)/(5) is
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Solve the complex fraction part directly: 1 / (1 + 4/9) = 1 / (13/9) = 9/13

Group and combine the remaining simple fractions: 2/5 − 4/5 = −2/5

Add the two results together: 9/13 − 2/5 = (45 − 26) / 65 = 19/65

**∴ The correct answer is 19/65.**
